cases.d: The Secretary records or uploads a recording with consent and gets a transcript.
steps: Open tab "Bản ghi" during the meeting.
Click "Bắt đầu ghi âm", enter Mục đích ghi âm "Lập biên bản cuộc họp", tick the consent statement and click "Bắt đầu ghi"; later stop and save ("Lưu tệp ghi âm").
Or click "Tải tệp ghi âm lên" and choose an audio file.
Open "Nghe và xem bản gỡ băng".
exp: "Đã lưu bản ghi." appears; the recording shows Ghi trực tiếp or Tải lên and "Đang chuyển chữ".
When done it shows "Có bản gỡ băng"; the transcript lists speakers and times.
Without ticking consent the recording cannot start.
pre: An InProgress meeting; signed in as its Secretary; speech worker running.

cases.d: The Secretary corrects the transcript and names speakers; members only listen.
steps: In the transcript click "Sửa đoạn này", change the text and Lưu.
As thanhvien, open the same transcript.
exp: "Đã lưu đoạn gỡ băng." and "Đã gán người nói." appear.
thanhvien can listen and read but has no edit actions.
pre: A recording with a completed transcript.

cases.d: Delete a recording; the audio and transcript are erased.
exp: "Đã xoá bản ghi." appears; the audio and its transcript are erased; the row shows Đã xoá and can no longer be played.
pre: A stored recording; signed in as the Secretary.

cases.d: Per-microphone capture turns each participant's sentences into text.
steps: In a per-microphone meeting room, open Lời nói and click "Ghi lời tôi".
Delete one of your sentences ("Xoá câu này").
exp: The status shows "Đang ghi"; each sentence appears as text under your name.
Deleting shows "Đã xoá câu nói." and the sentence leaves the transcript.
pre: An InProgress meeting whose Cách ghi âm is per microphone; speech worker running.
